propositions: The reconciler's committed .bridge_state cache accounts for 92% (≈956 MiB) of the tickets branch's 1.04 GiB size, driven by unnecessary bookkeeping fields that are written but never read.

Deleting the baseline_advanced_at timestamp field and moving last_get_pass rotation bookkeeping to a separate file reduces marginal packed cost per version from 12.79 KB to ≤3.2 KB (75% reduction needed to meet 25% of baseline criterion).

A one-time history rewrite using git fast-export/filter/fast-import can safely reduce the existing branch from ≈1.1 GiB to ≈99 MiB (8.4%) while preserving all commits, merges, and producing a byte-identical current HEAD tree.
Writers must refuse epoch-mismatched clones at both sync._union_merge and push.py before and after the rewrite to prevent stale-epoch commits.

All three format changes (A1: delete baseline_advanced_at; A2-1/A2-2: move last_get_pass; A3: normalize baseline text; A4: narrow prev_snapshot.json) must preserve mixed-version read compatibility with rollback capability via recorded forward/reverse corpus diffs.
